name: gloww-skincare
description: A modern skincare e-commerce storefront featuring product discovery, shopping cart, Stripe checkout, and newsletter signup.

paragraphs: A responsive storefront for GLOWW, a fictional botanical skincare brand. It's built with plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, with no framework, no build step and no npm packages. Payments, newsletter sign-up and the contact form run through four small Netlify Functions that call Stripe, Mailchimp and Resend.

GLOWW is an original brand made for this project. Product names, copy and packaging artwork are original. The packshots are generated by tools/generate-packshots.py. The homepage reviews are clearly labelled on the site as illustrative samples.
features: A catalog of 16 products across 8 categories, defined in one file (js/products.js). Every page reads from it, and so does the checkout function.
Live search by product, ingredient or skin need.
Filters for category, skin need and price range, with a "clear all" option.
Four sort orders and a no-results state.
Filter state is kept in the URL, so filtered views can be shared and bookmarked.
